WHAT: Six bugs found and fixed in the FN coordinator after architecture audit.

FIXES APPLIED:
1. Banner ordering: 'Toggle recording hotkey' check must come before 'Recording hotkey' — substring match was misclassifying toggle failures as push-to-talk.
2. Double-stop guard: added `state != CommandModeActive` guard on command key-up path — FN release and key-up were both firing StopCommandModeRecording.
3. FN+key toggle state: handle_shortcut_event now sets ToggleRecordingActive (or Idle) when FN+key toggle fires — previously left coordinator in Idle, breaking Escape/health-check cleanup.
4. Quick-stop via was_toggle_active: FnHeld release < 300ms now returns ToggleRecording if was_toggle_active=true — tap-to-stop works without waiting for debounce.
5. Settings read unified in handle_shortcut_event: pipeline_mode now read in same borrow as keybind strings (was two separate borrows, TOCTOU risk).
6. CancelPushToTalk renamed to CancelRecording throughout — action now used for all recording types including toggle.

ALSO ADDED: command mode can now be mapped to bare FN (was completely missing from all three handlers — handle_fn_key_event Pressed, Released, and check_fn_hold_action).

WHERE: src-tauri/src/features/hotkeys/service.rs

COMMIT: a02c255
